answer: Vesting with clawback: most of each reward stays locked and unlocks slowly over weeks. If auditors later prove an identity is a fake, for example by catching it reusing another seat's reasoning, its locked balance is burned and the loss can ripple to whoever vouched for it. A random beacon picks which past answers get re-audited, so no fake knows when it is safe. An attacker who farms a thousand seats sees earnings peak at their zenith on paper, yet can cash out only a sliver before one audit wipes the rest.
